rootCauseOneLine: createConnectServerSync.runSync() treats a null fetchServers() (no local runtime + no cached credential, or any RPC/gate failure) as a log-only silent no-op and never informs main.ts, so buildMenuServerItems maps an empty list and createServerMenuItems renders no empty-state row; the distinct reasons (503 disabled vs not_paired vs no credential) are available but discarded by design.

prReviews.verdict: REQUEST CHANGES (reporter's prototype branch Joesirven/bb@prototype/connect-server-list-skip-reason, no PR opened)
prReviews.topFinding: A skipped sync never triggers refreshApplicationMenu(); in the reporter's custom-target startup flow the last menu build (main.ts:1235) precedes connectServerSync.syncNow() (main.ts:2288) which sets the reason, and the remote config poll that would rebuild fails for an unreachable target, so the disabled note would not appear when it is needed. Also 'unavailable' mislabels 503/not_paired as 'could not reach bb Connect' though the server distinguishes them; skipReason set before await; optional+nullable serversNote; no tests.

proposedFix: In apps/desktop/src/connect-server-sync.ts make the sync outcome a value: return a discriminated result from fetchServers (no-local-server-no-credential; local-plugin-disabled from RPC 503; local-not-paired from {code:'handler_error',message:'not_paired'}; local-unreachable; gate-unauthorized/gate-unreachable from ConnectListError) by parsing rpcFailureSchema instead of discarding it, and add an onSkipped(reason) callback next to onServers. In main.ts store the reason beside connectAccountServers and call refreshApplicationMenu() from onSkipped too (Electron menus are immutable after build). In menu.ts render a required `serversNote: string | null` as a disabled item only when the connect list is empty and a reason exists, with labels per reason; update the 'stays quiet' test and add a menu test. Optionally add a clickable 'Sign in to bb Connect…' that switches to builtin and opens pairing (product decision). No wire/protocol impact.
caveats: No macOS available; the Server submenu was rendered with the real, unmodified menu.ts inside Electron 41.7.0 under Xvfb on Linux with the servers array main.ts produces for the reporter's state (isMac:false; template is platform-independent apart from role items). The prototype's main.ts ordering defect is from reading base main.ts control flow, not from running the prototype app. The reporter's claim that the menu had only 'This Mac' and 'Set Server URL…' is slightly off (a saved custom target also lists the custom host). Reporter's remedy ('sign in to Connect') would additionally require pairing the Mac's local server to the same account, since the desktop credential can only be enrolled via its own local server.
